name: dsh-app-packager
description: AppPackager for DeepSeek Harness · 用 HBuilderX 一键配好 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 环境，打出安装包并一键上传
author: lw0129a

capability.expected: also reads the HBuilderX version, recommends the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS SDK downloads and installs them from the panel, and can upgrade the plugin while keeping the downloaded SDKs; exposes app_packager_list / app_packager_doctor / app_packager_check / app_packager_build, driving the bundled bash engine (or the Node half on Windows), plus an AppPackager panel in the web GUI (environment check, project list, builds with live logs and cancel).

scripts.build: node scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/link-vendored-engine.mjs
scripts.prepack: node scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/link-vendored-engine.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm guard:check && pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/plugin.test.js && pnpm -C packages/app-packager test
scripts.doctor: pnpm -C packages/app-packager build && node packages/app-packager/dist/bin.js doctor
scripts.list: pnpm -C packages/app-packager build && node packages/app-packager/dist/bin.js list
